# Repeated purchase interaction

SHA-256: `5f2937cb3c00b4a4e965d1b350a3e71a61db144923caad73e21b6cf2c2a341ce`.

The production publisher builds two occurrences of the same Plan card with distinct view-model selections. Each has a generated nested interaction machine reporting `Nuxie Interaction` when its purchase button is tapped. Full authored source and publisher provenance are retained in that canonical SDK fixture.
